files.changes: no file chooser is opened or answered; the approved element itself must be an <input type=file>; it receives exactly the one host-staged path; occlusion typed (BR-04)

files.adapted: stage_upload, upload_binding and upload on BrowserWorker; the upload frame
files.changes: new code: the host copies the user's file from an approved folder, whose real path the caller binds from the folder approval (approved_folder_identity), into this lifetime's staging directory; the copy is held open (no writer, no deleter) for the lifetime and re-hashed before dispatch; the one-shot approval binds the committed origin, the source path, the size, the SHA-256 and the name; no document may open while the file is set

files.adapted: read: the create-free counterpart of commit
files.changes: new code: every folder and the file opened relative to their parent's handle with OBJ_DONT_REPARSE; nothing is created; a file with more than one hard link is refused; bounded; a root that no longer resolves to its approved path is refused

authority_delta: New approval-gated action: set a file input to a host-staged file. Setting it sends nothing by itself; the egress happens at a later, separately approved submission. The approval names the origin and the file's digest.
residuals: File choosers opened by custom buttons (no <input type=file> to set directly) are not answered.
The backlog's approval class (SOFT, or STRONG when the workspace is marked sensitive) is orceld's decision and is not wired; orceld and the MCP tool contract do not expose uploads yet.
Uploads inside frames are refused (main-frame refs only).

The host trusts its caller (orceld, once wired) to compute approved_folder_identity when the user approves the folder and to pass it back unchanged; nothing in the host checks that the folder was ever approved (as for downloads).
